text.Fortress Oblivion:
How to play ==
While Fortress Oblivion is in play, if you played a base this turn (including Fortress Oblivion), you may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. Fortress Oblivion is an Outpost with a defense of 4. 
 Strategy ==
Fortress Oblivion is a good card to buy in early game since it helps with cleaning the deck. It is fundamentally different from the other Year 1 Promo bases in two ways. First of all it is an outpost, which means that your opponent cannot just bypass it and leave it in play if you do not have other Bases, and second of all its defence is much lower (only 4). So don't expect this card to stay in play for multiple turns like the other promo bases might. But this does mean that this card is also useful if you don't have a lot of bases, since it will be taken out more quickly (absorbing 4 damage), after which you can play it again to scrap another card. But of course it is still more effective in a deck with more bases, since it may survive another turns in early game and then it is good to be able to scrap multiple cards with it. 

Later in the game this card loses its purpose, since scrapping is not useful anymore. Moreover it does not provide Combat or Authority, and it doesn't have high defense either. So it is usually not a good purchase later in the game.
